query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                SELECT 1
                FROM messages AS m
                INNER JOIN channel_memberships AS cm
                    ON cm.channel_id = m.channel_id AND cm.member_id = m.sender_id
                WHERE m.msg_id = $1 AND m.channel_id = $2
                  AND m.sender_type = 'user' AND m.sender_id = $3
                  AND cm.member_type = 'user'
            ) AS "value!"
